answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a metal-clad switchgear lineup with 15 kV vacuum circuit breakers, protective relays, and other components. The CROWN-ARMV product is an arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear lineup that meets IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B standards, making it suitable for this requirement.
This requirement pertains to compliance with standards and does not specify a product. The bid manager should address this requirement by ensuring compliance with the listed standards.

The requirement mentions special tools, maintenance equipment, and spare parts for the switchgear. The CROWN-ACC product includes accessories and hardware for MV switchgear, which aligns with this requirement.

This requirement describes the connection of the switchgear to feeders and underground cables, which is part of the installation process and not a product requirement. The bid manager should address this.
